gate_results.rationale: IT Gate, framing phase. Authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_IT shows technology_eol_months=4 (<12), triggering IT-EOL-001 (CREATE_CONVERGENCE_PLAN, REWORK). Capacity headroom is exactly 15%, which does not satisfy the '<15' predicate, so IT-CAPACITY-001 is not raised. CMDB record and run owner are present (CMDB_EXPORT corroborates: record_present=True, run_owner=Jeremy Meyer-12006-SO), catalog is standard with waiver, licence compliant, no duplicate capability, and change record approved — so no other IT findings apply at framing. REWORK is the highest-priority disposition among raised findings.

Architecture Gate, design phase. Authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_ARCHITECTURE raises exactly two findings. (1) ARCH-HA-001 (high, REWORK): business_criticality="High" with architecture_profile multi_az=false and multi_region=false — no zone or regional redundancy; corroborated by HLD ("Resilience: single_region_single_az", "Single-AZ / no AZ guarantee", "No dedicated DR region") and LLD ("Resilience: single_region_single_az", "Data replication: LRS only"). Action REDESIGN_FOR_HIGH_AVAILABILITY (Solution Architect); risk acceptance not allowed. (2) ARCH-REV-001 (medium, GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS): reversibility_status="missing"; corroborated by LLD ("Reversibility | missing"). Action COMPLETE_EXIT_ARCHITECTURE (Enterprise Architect). All other predicates are negative on the authoritative snapshot: ip_overlap=false (authoritative IP_PLAN shows overlap_detected=False for 10.166.96.0/24, 10.166.97.0/24, 10.166.98.0/24) so ARCH-IP-001 is not raised; api_gateway_required=true with api_gateway_present=true (LLD corroborates) so ARCH-API-001 is not raised; data_owner_present=true (DATA_MODEL/DATA_LINEAGE: owner Omar Ivanov-12006-BO, lineage complete) so ARCH-DATA-001 is not raised; measured_latency_ms=180 does not exceed latency_target_ms=200 so ARCH-PERF-001 is not raised. Highest-priority disposition among raised findings is REWORK. Authorization is not required: REWORK is not in authorization_required_for and no risk acceptance is requested (proposed actions are remediation design work, not completed remediation). Minor note: HLD artifact is labeled v2.5/v3 vs snapshot hld_version HLD-71C27-v4.1; the authoritative snapshot governs and the resilience facts are consistent across sources.

gate_results.rationale: Security Architecture Gate, design phase. Authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_SECURITY (age 0 days) raises exactly three findings. (1) SEC-VULN-001 (critical, NO_GO): critical_vulns_open=2; corroborated by authoritative VULN_SCAN showing CVE-2026-8000 and CVE-2026-8001 with severity Critical and status Open. Action REMEDIATE_CRITICAL_VULNERABILITIES (Product Team); risk acceptance not allowed. (2) SEC-LOG-001 (high, REWORK): logs_to_siem=false despite sentinel=true; corroborated by authoritative SENTINEL_STATUS (connectors=[]). Action CONNECT_LOGS_TO_SIEM (SOC); risk acceptance not allowed. (3) SEC-IAM-002 (high, REWORK): shared_service_principal=true. Action CREATE_DEDICATED_WORKLOAD_IDENTITY (IAM Team); risk acceptance not allowed. All other predicates are negative on the authoritative snapshot: internet_exposed=true with waf_present=true and waf_mode='Prevention' (WAF_POLICY corroborates present=true, mode=Prevention, OWASP managed rules) so SEC-WAF-001/SEC-WAF-002 are not raised; data_classification='Internal' (not Confidential/Restricted) and private_endpoints=true (KEYVAULT_CONFIG corroborates private_endpoint=true) so SEC-NET-001 is not raised; mfa='mandatory' so SEC-IAM-001 is not raised; phase is design (not build_acceptance) and pentest_status='pass' (age 14 days) so SEC-PENTEST-001 is not raised; key_rotation_days=90 (not None/365) so SEC-KEY-001 is not raised. Highest-priority disposition among raised findings is NO_GO, driven by the two open critical vulnerabilities. Authorization is required because NO_GO is in authorization_required_for; the active standing mandate MANDATE-5d8bb3b5-f441-5613-97ae-b69c2f6113ad-INTEGRATE-03-SECURITY-1 (Lucas Martin-12006-RO) is scoped to 'all and only risk-acceptable findings' and none of the raised findings permit risk acceptance (risk_acceptance_allowed=false for all three), so no conditional approval under the mandate is available — these findings require remediation, not acceptance. Proposed actions are remediation work, not completed remediation.

Legal Gate, design phase. Authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_LEGAL (age 0 days) raises exactly one finding: LEGAL-LOG-001 (high, REWORK) — log_export_clause="missing" while business_criticality="High"; the rule requires a log-export commitment for High/Critical services. Corroborated by MSA-71C27-3.5 §6 ("Security logs export: missing"), the negotiation log ("Security log export: missing"), and the authoritative CONTRACT_PLAYBOOK requirement ("security_log_export": "included for high/critical services"). Action ADD_LOG_EXPORT_CLAUSE (owner: Legal); risk acceptance is permitted for this finding but is not requested — the proposed action is remediation (adding the clause), not acceptance. All other predicates are negative on the authoritative snapshot: dpa_status="signed" with personal_data=true (no LEGAL-DPA-001); liability_cap_multiplier=1 with security_carveout=true (no LEGAL-LIAB-001); audit_right="full" (no LEGAL-AUDIT-001); exit_assistance_days=90 (no LEGAL-EXIT-001); ip_ownership="customer" (no LEGAL-IP-001); insurance_valid=true with cyber_insurance_m=20 (no LEGAL-INS-001); signing_authority_valid=true (no LEGAL-SIGN-001). Highest-priority disposition among raised findings is REWORK. Authorization is not required: REWORK is not in authorization_required_for, and no risk acceptance is requested, so the active standing mandate (scoped to risk-acceptable findings) is not engaged. Proposed actions are remediation work, not completed remediation.

Compliance Gate, design phase. Authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_COMPLIANCE (age 0 days) raises exactly two findings under DGF-decision-v8. (1) COMP-A11Y-001 (high, REWORK, risk_acceptance_allowed=true): accessibility_status="major_findings"; action REMEDIATE_ACCESSIBILITY (Product Team). (2) COMP-EXPORT-002 (high, SUSPENSION, risk_acceptance_allowed=false): export_control="pending"; action COMPLETE_EXPORT_CONTROL_REVIEW (Compliance). All other predicates are negative on the authoritative snapshot: dpia_required=true with dpia_status="complete" (corroborated by DPIA v5: "Required | True / Status | complete", residual risk owner Lucas Martin-12006-RO) so COMP-DPIA-001 is not raised; residency_compliant=true (authoritative DATA_INVENTORY: actual_region "West Europe", required_residency "EU") so COMP-RESID-001 is not raised; audit_trail="partial" and regulatory_mapping="partial" — the rule triggers only on the value "missing", so COMP-AUDIT-001 and COMP-MAP-001 are not raised (REG_MAPPING corroborates mapping_status="partial", owner GRC, regulation GDPR); export_control is "pending", not "restricted", so COMP-EXPORT-001 is not raised. Highest-priority disposition among raised findings is SUSPENSION, driven by the pending export-control screening. Authorization is required because SUSPENSION is in authorization_required_for. The active standing mandate MANDATE-5d8bb3b5-f441-5613-97ae-b69c2f6113ad-INTEGRATE-05-COMPLIANCE-1 (Lucas Martin-12006-RO) is scoped to "all and only risk-acceptable findings": COMP-EXPORT-002 does not permit risk acceptance, so the mandate cannot conditionally approve the suspension driver and the gate cannot advance until the export-control review completes; COMP-A11Y-001 permits risk acceptance but acceptance is not requested — remediation (REMEDIATE_ACCESSIBILITY) is the proposed action, consistent with the legal gate's treatment of its risk-acceptable finding in this run. Proposed actions are remediation work, not completed remediation.

General Gate, governance phase. Authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_GENERAL (age 0 days) raises exactly two findings under DGF-decision-v8. (1) GEN-BUDGET-001 (high, SUSPENSION, risk_acceptance_allowed=true): budget_requested_eur=500000 exceeds budget_approved_eur=350000; corroborated by authoritative BUDGET_APPROVAL v4 (requested_eur=500000, approved_eur=350000, status=PARTIAL, approver CFO Office). Action OBTAIN_BUDGET_APPROVAL (CFO / Sponsor). (2) GEN-UPSTREAM-NOGO (critical, NO_GO, risk_acceptance_allowed=false): 1 upstream gate returned NO_GO — Security (INTEGRATE-03-SECURITY-1, driven by 2 open critical vulnerabilities CVE-2026-8000/CVE-2026-8001 per its decision record). Action RESOLVE_UPSTREAM_NO_GO (Project Manager). All other predicates are negative on the authoritative snapshot: strategic_alignment="strong" (no GEN-STRAT-001); roi=0.391 is not below the 0.05 threshold (no GEN-BC-001); phase is governance, not deployment_closure (no GEN-BENEFITS-001); the upstream elif chain fires only the NO_GO branch, so the Compliance SUSPENSION and the IT/Architecture/Legal REWORK results are subsumed and do not raise GEN-UPSTREAM-SUSPEND or GEN-UPSTREAM-REWORK. Highest-priority disposition among raised findings is NO_GO. Authorization is required because NO_GO is in authorization_required_for. The active standing mandate MANDATE-5d8bb3b5-f441-5613-97ae-b69c2f6113ad-INTEGRATE-06-GENERAL-1 (Lucas Martin-12006-RO) is scoped to "all and only risk-acceptable findings": GEN-UPSTREAM-NOGO does not permit risk acceptance, so the mandate cannot conditionally approve the NO_GO driver; GEN-BUDGET-001 permits risk acceptance but none is requested — the proposed action is remediation (obtaining the missing budget approval), not acceptance. Proposed actions are remediation work, not completed remediation.
